rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a formal conference or organized meeting.

example.english: Several industry experts are speakers at this conference.
example.traditional: 今次會議有幾位業界專家做講者。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 jau5 gei2 wai2 jip6 gaai3 zyun1 gaa1 zou6 gong2 ze2

rows.note: Use this for an academic conference where researchers present and discuss their work.

example.english: This academic conference brings many scholars together to discuss their research.
example.traditional: 呢個學術研討會有好多學者交流研究。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hok6 seot6 jin4 tou2 wui6 jau5 hou2 do1 hok6 ze2 gaau1 lau4 jin4 gau3

rows.note: Use this for a large organization- or industry-wide convention focused on a public or business issue.

example.english: The conference our company is holding next month will invite several industry representatives to speak.
example.traditional: 公司下個月搞嘅大會會請幾位業界代表上台。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 gaau2 ge3 daai6 wui6 wui5 ceng2 gei2 wai2 jip6 gaai3 doi6 biu2 soeng5 toi4
